ops.title: Apple-side setup for a new signed helper app (App IDs + Developer ID profiles)
ops.description: One-time Apple Developer portal work (team SXKCTF23Q2) required before a repo's first release-app.yml signed release. Profiles are FETCHED by name at build time (xcodebuild -allowProvisioningUpdates authed by the notary API key) — they must pre-exist with byte-exact names matching the repo's project.yml PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER and the release workflow's profile_names input. Mirror of cc-pool's setup (cc-pool ccn b03f9f9/eac747e). Never revoke existing certificates (cap of 5); only ADD. captain-hook concretely: App IDs com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper ('Captain Hook Helper') + com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper.widget ('Captain Hook Helper Widget'), profiles 'Captain Hook Helper App' / 'Captain Hook Helper Widget', group SXKCTF23Q2.com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper (TeamID-prefixed, not group.*).

ops.text: Warm cookiesync from a real GUI terminal (headless agents die on the cold biometric path): cookiesync auth --browser arc --ttl 30m --reason '<task>' + Touch ID tap
Seed an agent-browser session for developer.apple.com (abwc-seed) and verify logged-in via snapshot
Open an existing App ID with App Groups (e.g. 'cc-pool Status Host') and note its App Groups capability config — it authorizes SXKCTF23Q2.*; mirror it, don't invent a group registration
Create each explicit macOS App ID (bundle id + human description), enabling App Groups configured the same way
Create one Developer ID provisioning profile per App ID, binding the existing Developer ID Application cert, named byte-exactly as frozen in project.yml + the workflow's profile_names
Download each .provisionprofile; security cms -D -i <file>; assert Name exact, TeamIdentifier SXKCTF23Q2, and the app-groups entitlement covers the repo's group
Push the six release secrets if absent: set-release-secrets.sh <owner/repo> (repo-bootstrap skill), verify gh secret list shows 6
